name: phase-zero-bootstrap
title: Phase Zero Bootstrap
description: Build the reproducible local Rust/Docker development environment and upstream iroh-relay deployment bundle, stop at the public-server access checkpoint, then deploy and verify after user-provided access.
creator: leon
notes: Derived from the approved parent plan. The selected public host uses same-host OpenResty TLS termination to loopback port 38451. Relay fallback is independent of QAD and is complete without UDP; QAD is only an optional direct-path address-discovery aid. Keep UDP 7842 closed, make no firewall change, and defer any QAD-only decision until empirical Phase 1 NAT/path-events testing.
